model.title: Railroad Retirement Board Stability Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Bill Cassidy (R-LA)

summary.text: The bill would change how the Railroad Retirement Board pays for its administrative costs by creating a dedicated account within the Treasury that can be used to run the agency's retirement and unemployment programs for railroad workers. It would limit how much money can be moved into that account each year from the board's other funds for fiscal years 2027 through 2031 and from fiscal year 2032 onward, and it would set aside money in a technology fund to modernize the board's old benefit processing systems. The bill would also authorize additional funding for unforeseen claims processing needs and for future system modernization. It would require the Government Accountability Office to report on ways to modernize those systems and to follow up later on the board's progress. Finally, it would move the due date for certain single-employer pension plan premiums for plan years starting after December 31, 2035, and before January 1, 2037, to the fifteenth day of the ninth calendar month beginning on or after the first day of the premium payment year.
